summary: Iteration 34 — Laudo de Transformador (padrão Energisa). Backend: 19/19 pytest passed covering GET/PUT/photo-slots/from-photo/DELETE/PDF endpoints, prefill (patrimonio/serie/marca/reformado from condicao=reforma), validations (tipo_laudo/configuracao/tipo_oleo/reformado → 400), leituras normalized to length 3, non-image rejection, 404 unknown eid/photo_id, and PDF (application/pdf, %PDF magic, 1 page, size >20KB with slot photos, works with placeholders when no laudo saved). Frontend: EquipamentosPage renders equip-laudo-{id} only on transformer cards; laudo-modal opens with prefilled fields (PAT-OPHOJE, SN-1, WEG, project 122601797, encarregado 'João da Silva'); all toggle testids present (tipo/configuracao/classe/oleo/reformado); all 8 slots have laudo-slot/camera/upload/pick/file testids; save→toast 'Laudo salvo'; close+reopen persists observação/posicao_tap/aterr_leituras-0; PNG upload on tensao_a via set_input_files renders laudo-slot-img-tensao_a (naturalWidth=200) and remove clears it; laudo-slot-pick-placa correctly disabled when equip_photos empty; laudo-pdf triggers download 'Laudo_Transformador_122601797.pdf' 69214 bytes with toast 'Laudo PDF gerado'; mobile 390px scrollWidth==390 (no horizontal overflow); laudo-close closes modal.

SLOTS/FIELDS listas duplicadas do frontend LaudoTrafoModal (SLOT_GROUPS) — se alguém adicionar slot, precisa sincronizar 2 lados. Aceitável para MVP.
